en: Why are you here?
Where the fuck else could I be. You got some room in your shack? Eh? Got a spare bed for Petar? Thought not.
You been sitting there a while?
Even for a Vulture, you're fucking clueless. Don't know how it feels, do ya? To be immobilized from hunger.
Dipshits like you don't care 'bout folk. Thankfully some Acolytes saved my sorry skin a couple times before. Tho they gotta believe in "God" to do anything decent.
You don't have any way to make money?
You think it's fuckin' easy? Look, I'm a tinker. Repair tools and shacks, fix shit. Stuff that's too simple for Mechanists.
Or stuff that's supposed to be cheap, 'cuz I don't overcharge like those fucking geeks.
I also sell some info, 'cuz I'm smart as shit. I don't look it, but I am. That answer your question, asshole?
So you can't get much work – wonder why that is...
Fucker. Look, I'm a tinker first and a peddler second. I know how to work. Problem is, you spend enough time without a bath, even Mudlarks start looking at you with disgust...
Your disgust, however, means jack shit to me. So if you don't have anythin' to spare, just fuckin' leave.
Get much change with that attitude?
Fuck off. What do you know about peddlin'?
You get along with the other folk?
What do you mean by that exactly? Fuckin' Vulture on his high horse?
Listen, I keep my ear to the grapevine. When folks are disgusted by you, they act like you're not there.
And eventually, it's like you really aren't. They open up around each other. "It's fine, stupid bum doesn't understand us".
... And what good comes of that?
What do you think, idiot. Information! About all these different groups fightin' for power in this shithole. About Mutants, too. And it's cheap if you want it.
So you're good at eavesdropping. Who cares?
You should care, dumbass. Ain't that part of your trade? Huh? Knowin' how shit works, so you can carefully sidestep it like any other cowardly Vulture?
What do you mean, you sell info?
It's not some fucking code, is it. I get money, you get details on all the cool stuff I know, which you don't, 'cuz you're a loner. And that's coming from a fuckin' bum.
So, you want that kinda info, it'll cost ya. Nothing free in this bitch of a place. You know that, scavenger and all.
What's the word around here?
Gotta be more specific...
Anything going down between factions?
Well, Gunners and Palatines at each other's throats like always. You know how it is.
Only, word is the Gunners've set up a camp smack dab in front of that Palatine base, Arcadia.
We might be about to see some major shit go down...
Anything else?
Well, there's some bad blood between Rada and the Acolytes...
Ain't like somethin' specific has happened yet, but... Let's just say they don't always see eye to eye.

Rada act like their little group knows what's best for everybody, like they help just out of the kindness in their hearts. Acolytes tryin' to make sure no-one does anything decent in this shithole 'less they say a prayer first.
If they just joined forces and stopped fuckin' bickerin', people like me wouldn't be starving in the goddamn streets.
About something else, then.
Shoot.
Heard of any work for a Vulture?
Shit, you're a shameless one, ain't ya.
Yeah, there's a couple people in the Mire with requests. Try Vesna, the seamster woman. Or Rosa, she's the cook.
Shit, wait, don't call Rosa a "cook". Use the word "chef". She goes crazy if you don't.
What do you know about the Mist?
I know everyone's obsessed with this shit... But I just don't get it.
Ain't this Mist the same thing smallpox used to be? Like, the plague 'n shit? All these fuckin' diseases done wiped out half humanity?
What exactly is the difference? Everybody knows that them rich folk from the East found a way around it. 'Course they just ain't willin' to share it with the rest of us.
So it really don't concern me, 'cuz it's the same shit as always – the rich raw-doggin' the poor, folks like you spittin' on me as they pass, and on and on it goes. Then we die.
Ain't some Mist gonna signify nothin' major in a few years, man.
Do you know a lot about Mutants?
I listen to what them Palatines and Vultures have to say, sure. But they're the ones fighting those critters, not the ones being massacred by them on the daily.

Commonfolk's the ones who really know what they are, what they used to be... And what to call 'em. Their names all come from legend, from myths, kinda stories get passed down 'tween folks with not a fuckin' twig to their name... Folks who are scared.
First thing you do when you fear somethin' is give it a name, y'know. Be it violence, solitude, memories. Love. All that crap...
Shit, you don't wanna hear some fuckin' bum yap on 'bout all that...
Tell me about Mutants.
Long as you know this is gonna cost ya...
Changing the subject.
I'd better go.
That hound-looking thing...
That's one of the most common Mutants around here, for sure. We have a name for them: Drekavacs, after those mythological, ghost-like critters. But you can just call 'em Hounds, too.
They're usually out huntin' in packs, so if you see the one, prepare for more. Also, they're quick, and unlike some other Mutants, they'll chase you down pretty relentlessly.
What's with those big-ass rats?
They're called Moras. Not much to them other than bein' ugly. But it's the Mother Moras you have to watch out for.
They're the really big ones who can birth more and more critters while attacking you. Needless to say, if you see one of those you either run or focus all your fire on them.
That plant which shoots acid...
Oh, yeah; Woundworts. It's like a mutated flower mixed with a big tree, only it can aim those acid blobs like a damn mortar. Pretty scary if you don't see them coming.
They like hiding within Mist, which makes it harder to get through those spots – run without thinking and you'll find some of those blobs headed your way from who knows where...
That plant with the sprouting vines...
You mean the Tormentils? Yeah, they're nasty. Can wrap around your limbs in a flash when you're not looking. You'll have to be pretty quick on your feet to handle those.
And they like hangin' out near other Mutants too – might be a good idea to focus your fire on them first, if you're fightin' a whole group.
Know any others?
I know 'em all, but like I keep sayin'. My throat is dry.
Let me rest up and drink up 'fore you keep askin' me this shit.
About something else.
I've gotta go.
Well don't you look fuckin' LOADED... C'mon, spare some change for this poor beggar?
I'm fuckin' hungry...
Please... Throat's dry as shit.
Damn it... Spare some change?
Let's talk.
Want to talk.
Got questions.
Got some things to spare.
I can give you something.
Here's some stuff I can spare.
Obliged...
Well color me surprised...
Anything you got is a huge help...
Aren't ya big-hearted...
Food, water, money... Please...
Alright, buzz off already.
Leave me be then.
Spare some more next time, cheapskate...
Fuckin' cheapskate... See ya...
